title: Main Prem Ki Diwani Hoon
desc: Sanjana is to get married with NRI Prem. However, theres a chaos when she falls in love with his employee Prem Kishen while Prem Kumar is delayed. How will it affect Sanjana?

title: Aashiq Hoon Baharon Ka
desc: Framed for stealing uranium, a dedicated scientist battles to clear his name, uncover conspiracies, and protect the woman he loves in this gripping romantic thriller.

title: Suhaag
desc: Ajay and Raj, notorious college pranksters, constantly land in trouble. When Ajay applies for a passport, he uncovers a shocking secret about his real identity, changing his life.

title: Koyla
desc: Shankar, a mute servant, tricks Gauri into marrying his employer with a false photo. But Gauri falls for Shankar, fighting against odds to be with him.

title: Ghatak: Lethal
desc: Kashi witnesses the brutal rule of Katya during a visit with his father. As he dares to resist the oppression, his actions endanger the lives of his family and loved ones.

title: Cheeni Kum
desc: Buddhadev, a 64-year-old chef, falls for Nina, 34. Their future is shaken when he learns her father is six years younger than him, casting doubt on their relationship.

title: Sooryavanshi
desc: With Mumbai under threat of a major terrorist attack, ATS chief Sooryavanshi launches a high-stakes mission to track down 600 kg of missing RDX and the masterminds behind the plot.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Ayassh Dil
desc: Malay is a successful journalist, but his personal life spins out of control when he gets romantically involved with several women despite being married.

title: Kishen Kanhaiya
desc: Twin brothers Kishen and Kanhaiya, separated at birth - one rich, and one poor - reunite years later to join forces and battle evil, proving blood ties conquer all odds.

title: Sirf Tum
desc: Deepak and Aarti fall in love through letters without ever meeting or knowing each other's address. Longing to see him, Aarti finally travels to Delhi to search for her true love.

title: Tezaab
desc: After his parents' murder, Mahesh is imprisoned and separated from Mohini, who suffers under her cruel father. Years later, he returns to rescue her and avenge his past.

title: Khiladiyon Ka Khiladi
desc: Akshay joins Maya's gang while searching for his missing brother. To earn her trust, he must prove his strength and defeat his rival in a wrestling match.

title: Gangaajal
desc: IPS Amit Kumar, an honest cop, is posted to a crime-ridden town. He battles ruthless criminals, crooked officers, and shady politicians to restore law and justice.

title: Akhanda 2: Thaandavam
desc: As biological warfare threatens the country, a scientist seeks a cure. But when dangerous forces target her, a warrior returns to defend humanity.

title: Dhaakad
desc: Agent Agni reluctantly accepts a mission to capture Rudraveer, a dangerous trafficker. Her journey takes unexpected turns, pushing her into uncharted paths filled with risk and discovery.
